experiment: Model-matched EBSS reproduction + Probability-Only ablation (pilot 16 x 512, one seed)

hypotheses.H1: EBSS balancing reduces expert-exposure inequality vs Probability-Only (tested)
hypotheses.H2: balance guidance may improve the lower tail but change distribution/diversity (tested)
hypotheses.H3: probability-only beam generation may be repetitive; EBSS may mitigate or worsen (tested)
hypotheses.H4: better balance need not improve GPTQ reconstruction (B=16 pilot only)
hypotheses.H5: generation overhead may dominate calibration cost (measured)

choices.usage_frequency: u_l^e = (# tokens of the branch routed to expert e at layer l, top-k membership, each token once per selected expert) / (# tokens of the branch). Paper: 'usage frequency', normalisation undocumented. Per-token rate chosen because it reproduces the scale of the authors' reported Expert Balance STD (rebuttal: wikitext2 0.0427 / EBSS 0.0052 on 64-expert DeepSeek).
choices.routed_counts_not_affinities: counts of selected (top-k) experts; routing probabilities are not used
choices.shared_expert: excluded (always active; not part of the 60 routed experts)
choices.layers_in_sigma: all 24 MoE layers (Eq. 3: L = number of MoE layers); layers 1/8/16/23 reported separately
choices.balance_scope: per branch (prefix S of the candidate); no state is shared between sentences
choices.first_token: uniform Random(V) over the non-special tokenizer ids 0..151642 with numpy default_rng(INIT_SEED); sampled once and shared by both methods
choices.first_token_logprob: the unconditioned first token contributes 0 to R; it counts toward |S| and the 512 tokens and its routing counts toward sigma
choices.vocabulary_V: tokenizer ids 0..151645 (all real tokens incl. the 3 specials); embedding padding rows 151646..151935 (never trained) are excluded
choices.eos: no stop rule (Algorithm 1 iterates exactly Seqlen-1 steps over all of V); an EOS/special token is an ordinary candidate and generation continues; every one of the 512 tokens is a real model choice
choices.length: Seqlen = 512 counts the first token: 1 random + 511 generated; no padding
choices.final_selection: argmin Score(c) over the w surviving branches (Alg. 1 line 20 says argmax; resolved to the minimisation objective of Eq. 9-10/13)
choices.ties: candidates ordered by (score, parent beam index, token id): stable sort of the flattened [w, V] score array; final selection ties -> lowest beam index
choices.sentence_batching: all sentences decoded in lock-step in one batch (rebuttal R3/R6: sequences stitched along the batch dimension); KV cache reordered by parent index after every pruning
choices.precision: BF16 weights/activations, eager attention; log_softmax in fp32; R and scores in fp64

methods.PROBABILITY_ONLY: Eq. 13 score without the balance term (identical candidates, normalisation, scheduling, starts)

generator.no_tuning: w, tau, starts, seed fixed before any generation; no repetition penalty, no sampling temperature, no top-k/nucleus sampling, no prompt template

smoke.replay_tolerance: batch-1 no-cache replay of every chosen smoke sequence: mean |delta log p| <= 0.05 nats and Pearson r >= 0.99 (BF16 batch-shape rounding; exact equality is not expected, see update_batch_sensitivity.md)

gptq_pilot.rtn_fallback: E3 semantics preserved (zero-token experts fall back to RTN); counted and reported, never presented as GPTQ

decision_rule.precedence: RUN-BLOCKED -> QUALITY-GAIN (only if the optional B=16 GPTQ comparison completed validly) -> balancing classes
decision_rule.RUN-BLOCKED: a generator correctness gate fails, the 16 x 512 pilot does not complete for BOTH methods, a generated set is invalid (not 16 distinct full 512-token sequences of real ids), or resources prevent the measurement
decision_rule.MODEL-MATCHED-EBSS-QUALITY-GAIN: B=16 GPTQ valid for all configs AND EBSS mean reconstruction is lower than Probability-Only by >= 0.5 % AND lower than every C4 Random B=16 seed AND >= 0.5 % lower than the C4 Random seed mean
decision_rule.MODEL-MATCHED-EBSS-BALANCING-SUPPORTED: EBSS set-level paper sigma (Eq. 3/4, all 24 MoE layers) AND mean per-layer load CV (all 24 layers) are both lower than Probability-Only
decision_rule.MODEL-MATCHED-EBSS-BALANCING-NOT-SUPPORT: neither is lower (EBSS equal or worse on both)
decision_rule.MODEL-MATCHED-EBSS-MIXED: exactly one of the two balance metrics is lower
decision_rule.notes: set-level metrics over the 16 x 512 = 8,192 tokens of each set; lower-tail exposure (min / p5 / p10 / zero-exposure experts), per-layer results and layers 1/8/16/23 are reported separately and do not enter the label. With exactly k = 4 routed experts per token the per-layer mean count is fixed, so sigma_l and CV_l are proportional within a layer; the two means can still differ only through layer weighting (ddof differs). One seed, one start-token draw: no statistical generality.

hard_constraints: no checkpoint change, no chat model, no quantized generator, no AGQ, no GPTQ change, no new sampling, no repetition penalty, no tau/w tuning, same starts for both methods, no padding, no C4 mixing, no held-out-based sample selection, no automatic B=128 run

amendments.text: Decision metrics (paper sigma, mean per-layer CV over 24 layers) are computed from the CANONICAL-B1 replay routing of the generated 16 x 512 sets (the routing the calibration pipeline and the C4 comparisons see). Generation-time (batched KV-decode) routing statistics are reported alongside; their token-layer agreement with the replay is reported.
